operations.setup: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm exec rer install
operations.verify: pnpm run verify && pnpm check:deployment-spec && pnpm exec rer check --profile first-party
operations.recovery: Follow OPERATIONS.md: stop writes and scheduled sends, retain the exact source and private configuration, export the database and ORIGINALS bucket, restore into fresh empty resources with unchanged migration bytes, run setup for a fresh owner, then re-export and compare native rows and original files before routing traffic.
